start.title: Get started with health and safety
start.body: Four steps give you the basics most audits ask for. You can do them in any order.

first_sja.title: Write your first safe job analysis
first_sja.body: Pick a risky job you do soon and go through it step by step with the people who do it.

first_ppe.title: Register your protective equipment
first_ppe.body: Add helmets, harnesses and other gear that must be inspected, so nobody uses something overdue.

first_consultation.title: Plan a meeting with the safety representative
first_consultation.body: Workers must take part in health and safety decisions. Record the meeting and what you agreed.

plan_safety_round.title: Plan regular safety rounds
plan_safety_round.body: A walk-around with a checklist finds hazards before they hurt someone.

list.title: Safe job analysis (SJA)
list.subtitle: Plan risky jobs step by step with the people who do them: what can go wrong, and what keeps everyone safe.
list.search: Search title, code, place or job

fields.title: Job title
fields.step_description: What is done in this step

edit.title: Edit safe job analysis
edit.jobIntro: plans a risky job before it starts. Write it with the people who will do the work.
edit.stepsIntro: Split the job into steps in the order they are done. Each step needs at least one hazard and one control before it can be sent for approval.
edit.riskIntro: The residual risk should be lower than the risk before controls. If it is still high, find better controls before work starts.
edit.controlsHint: start with the most effective. Tag each control so the analysis shows when a step only relies on PPE.
edit.controlPlaceholder: What is done to prevent it
edit.controlTypeN: Type of control {{ n }} in step {{ step }}
edit.removeControl: Remove control {{ n }} in step {{ step }}
edit.ppeOnlyWarning: This step relies only on PPE. Can the hazard be removed, or a barrier or routine be used instead?
edit.responsibleHint: Pick a member, or choose “Someone outside” and type the name.
edit.ppeHint: The equipment everyone doing the job must wear. The analysis shows which items in the PPE register cover it.
edit.jobSectionHint: A safe job analysis plans a risky job before it starts. Write it with the people who will do the work.
edit.peopleSectionHint: The people who do the job and go through the analysis together.

detail.noStepsYet: No job steps yet. Edit the analysis to split the job into steps.
detail.noSteps: Add at least one job step with a hazard and a control before you send it for approval.
detail.incomplete: Every step needs at least one hazard and one control before you send it for approval. Check step {{ steps }}.

signOff.title: Participants and sign-off
signOff.hint: Everyone who does the job confirms they went through the analysis before work starts.
signOff.recordFor: Record that {{ name }} has gone through it
signOff.done: The sign-off of {{ name }} was recorded.
signOff.afterSubmit: Participants can sign off once the analysis has been sent for approval.
signOff.noParticipants: No participants yet. Edit the analysis to add the people who will do the job.

ppe.hint: Items in the PPE register for each required category, with who holds them and when they are due.
ppe.none: No PPE is required for this job.

warning.none: There is nothing in the PPE register for this category. Register it or buy it before work starts.
warning.all_overdue: Every item in this category is overdue for inspection or expired. Inspect or replace it before work starts.

warnings.residual_not_lower: The residual risk is not lower than the risk before controls. Check that the controls really reduce the risk.
warnings.residual_high_approved: The analysis is approved with a {{ level }} residual risk. Consider better controls, or confirm that the risk is acceptable.
warnings.ppe_only_controls: Step {{ steps }} relies only on PPE. Look for controls higher up the hierarchy.
warnings.self_approved: The owner approved their own analysis. Another person should check it when possible.
warnings.sign_offs_missing: {{ count }} participants have not signed off yet.

completeCheck.title: Mark as completed without all sign-offs?
completeCheck.message: {{ count }} participants have not confirmed that they went through the analysis. You can still mark the job as completed.

reasonMessage.submit: Add a note for the approver.
reasonMessage.approve: Add a note for the owner.
reasonMessage.return: Tell the owner what needs to change before it can be approved.
reasonMessage.revise: Why does this approved analysis need to change? It goes back to draft, sign-offs are cleared and it must be approved again.
reasonMessage.complete: Add a note about how the job went.
reasonMessage.cancel: Why is this analysis being cancelled?

done.return: {{ code }} was sent back to draft.
done.revise: {{ code }} is back in draft for revision.

ai.applied: {{ count }} suggested steps were added. Check them before you save.
ai.review: Ask the assistant to review this analysis
ai.reviewPrompt: Review this safe job analysis draft: are any hazards or controls missing, and do the controls follow the hierarchy of controls?
ai.summarisePrompt: Summarise safe job analysis {{ code }}: the job, the main hazards, the controls, the residual risk and who has signed off.
ai.checkPrompt: Check safe job analysis {{ code }} for gaps an auditor would see: missing hazards, controls that rely only on PPE, PPE that is not in the register, and missing sign-offs.
ai.hazardsPrompt: Which hazards should I consider for this job step? Give examples for typical Norwegian workplaces.
ai.controlsPrompt: Which controls would work for these hazards? Order them by the hierarchy of controls.
ai.residualPrompt: How do I judge the residual risk after the controls, and when is it acceptable to start the work?

statusLine.draft: Draft – the analysis is not approved yet. Work must not start before it is approved.
statusLine.in_review: Awaiting approval – work can start once the analysis is approved.
statusLine.approved: Approved – the work can be done with the controls in the analysis.
statusLine.cancelled: Cancelled – the analysis is not in use.

lead.signed: Reviewed by the people doing the job

missing.steps: Split the job into steps with hazards and controls

list.title: PPE register
list.subtitle: Personal protective equipment: who has it, and when it must be inspected or replaced.

edit.title: Edit PPE item
edit.whoSection: Where it is and who is responsible
edit.standardHint: For example EN 397 for helmets or EN 361 for harnesses.
edit.supplierHint: Pick it from the Suppliers register, so evaluations and contracts are one click away.
edit.quantityHint: 1 for personal gear that must be traced, such as a fall-arrest harness. More than 1 for a batch on the shelf: issuing part of it creates its own record for that person.
edit.courseHint: The course a holder must have done, for example working at height. Issuing warns if the holder has not done it.
edit.intervalHint: How often the item must be inspected. Choose a common interval or type the number of days.
edit.whatSectionHint: The equipment, its category and how many there are.
edit.whoSectionHint: Where the equipment is kept and who follows it up.
edit.inspectionSectionHint: When it was last checked, when it is due again and when it expires.

detail.batchNote: A batch. Issuing part of it creates its own record for the holder.
detail.fromBatch: Split off a batch: open the batch
detail.overdueNotice: The inspection is overdue. Do not use or issue this item until it has passed an inspection.
detail.expiredNotice: This item has expired. Take it out of use and replace it.
detail.failedCallout: The last inspection failed. Report a deviation, so the cause is found and the gear is replaced.

issue.title: Issue PPE
issue.holderName: Or type the name of someone outside the organisation
issue.quantityHint: Leave blank to issue the whole batch. Fewer units become their own record for this person.

training.valid: {{ course }} is done and valid until {{ date }}.
training.expired: The holder's {{ course }} has expired. Renew the training before you issue the item.
training.missing: The holder has not done {{ course }}. Plan the training before you issue the item.
training.unknown: The holder's training for {{ course }} could not be checked.

inspection.title: Record an inspection
inspection.failNote: A failed inspection takes the item out of service and notifies the health and safety managers. You can then create a deviation from the item.
inspection.nextHint: Leave blank to use the inspection interval.

done.issuedPart: {{ count }} units were issued as {{ code }}.
done.inspected: The inspection of {{ code }} was recorded.
done.inspectionFailed: The failed inspection was recorded, and {{ code }} is now out of service.

ai.summarisePrompt: Summarise PPE item {{ code }}: its status, holder, inspection history and what is due next.
ai.standardPrompt: Which European standard (EN) applies to this kind of personal protective equipment, and what does it mean for inspection?

statusLine.in_stock: In stock – ready to be issued.
statusLine.out_of_service: Out of service – do not use until it has been inspected and passed.
statusLine.inspectionOverdue: Inspection overdue – do not use or issue the equipment until it passes a new inspection.
statusLine.expired: Expired – take the equipment out of use and replace it.
statusLine.retired: Retired – the equipment is out of use.
